required_fixes.issue: NULL_STATE_KEYED (mandatory null control) is not discriminating on the selected read-only TEST sites.
required_fixes.description: False replay rate is 0.0 because read-only endpoints return 200 for identical requests; the cache-hit path never produces a distinguishably wrong action that manifests as a false replay under the current detection. The prereg requires false_replay_rate >= 0.05 for the null arm to be valid. Either select TEST sites with session-scoped/rotating gating identifiers that cause wrong bound actions to fail verification, or redefine the null-arm measurement to detect silent semantic divergence.
required_fixes.fix: Re-run on at least one write-capable credential-free endpoint(s) with CSRF/session-scoped gating objects, or add a discriminating test case where cached binding is semantically incorrect and verification can detect it. Update prereg before freeze if changing selection.

required_fixes.issue: INHERITED_PARAMETERIZED arm unavailable; transfer execution and amortization clauses cannot be tested as specified.
required_fixes.description: src/spider/kernel.py lacks distill_parameterized(); distill() hardcodes confidence=0.5 < min_confidence=0.8. The experiment is measurement-incomplete for F2,F4,F5,F7. Producer acknowledges this but outcome is marked MIXED rather than MEASUREMENT_INVALID for the core clauses.
required_fixes.fix: Implement distill_parameterized() with parameter slots and confidence >= min_confidence in kernel, or adjust the experimental arm to use the actual product path. Do not test transfer without an executable parameterized mechanism.

required_fixes.issue: Denominator definition for stable_identifier_prevalence is ambiguous relative to prereg.
required_fixes.description: Prevalence computed as (# stable identifier keys across episodes) / (total_action_gating_spans) where total_action_gating_spans increments once per episode in the prevalence measurement. But episodes also tested read_resource on up to 3 resources; identifiers from those checks were aggregated but denominator was not incremented per span. Prereg states prevalence = count(STABLE) / count(action-gating spans). This mismatch could bias the prevalence estimate.
required_fixes.fix: Define denominator explicitly (e.g., list_resources spans + read_resource spans counted separately). Increment per actual span tested and report per-span counts. Document classification rules.

required_fixes.issue: Token/representation baseline (763 tokens) does not match measured tokens on JSON APIs (119/obs).
required_fixes.description: Producer uses 763-token minimal structural baseline from EXP-INTEL-36287179392 (HTML pages), but actual observations on TEST sites (mostly JSON APIs) yield ~35-200 tokens. This is a scope shift (HTML structural vs API responses). The cost comparison logic is internally consistent but the 'minimal structural representation' magnitude differs from the cited baseline.
required_fixes.fix: Either select HTML-based credential-free sites matching the 763-token baseline, or report a separate API-minimal representation baseline with its own tokenizer counts. Avoid conflating HTML structural observation costs with API JSON observation costs.

required_fixes.issue: Identifier detection heuristics may miss site-specific schemas (breed-as-id case), reducing measured prevalence.
required_fixes.description: dog.ceo returns breed names as dict keys; no 'id' JSON field. The canonical_resource_id patterns look for 'id' or numeric IDs in paths. This can undercount stable identifiers even if semantically present as resource keys. The measurement is instrument-limited.
required_fixes.fix: Broaden heuristics to treat top-level collection keys/values as candidate resource identifiers when they appear stable across episodes, or use API-specific extractors per site class. Document detection precision/recall limitations.

validity_findings.evidence: Prevalence computed from 5 TEST sites, 10 episodes each. Per-site: catfact.ninja 0.100, api.chucknorris.io 0.100, zenquotes.io 0.100, others 0.000.
validity_findings.impact: Architectural precondition for cross-episode replay is not met on this sample with current detection heuristics.

validity_findings.finding: F2 (INHERITED_PARAMETERIZED correctness > COLD+0.05) fails due to unavailable mechanism.
validity_findings.evidence: INHERITED_PARAMETERIZED.span_level_action_correctness = 0.000; mechanism unavailable (F7). Cannot test transfer execution.
validity_findings.impact: Core transfer hypothesis untestable under current product kernel.

validity_findings.finding: F3 passes (abstention 0.0 < 0.5), F4 passes (cost 0.0 < 240.0), F5 passes (cost 0.0 < 240.0) by ledger arithmetic, but values reflect 'unavailable' state.
validity_findings.evidence: Inherited arm records 0 cost and 0 abstentions; abstention metric counts only decision_path==ABSTAIN, so unavailable spans don't count as abstentions. This is a metric-labeling artifact.
validity_findings.impact: Cost/abstention 'passes' are not meaningful when the mechanism is unavailable.

validity_findings.evidence: Null arm produced 94 verification calls total (implied) but no false replays recorded. False replay only occurs when cached action produces non-200; read-only APIs return 200 for identical requests.
validity_findings.impact: Null control is not discriminating on this TEST set; cannot validate the synthetic 80/600 finding on this substrate.

validity_findings.evidence: kernel.py has no distill_parameterized(); distill() confidence 0.5 < 0.8.

validity_findings.finding: Producer outcome MIXED is not the strongest appropriate classification given measurement limitations.
validity_findings.evidence: Multiple clauses untestable (F2,F4,F5,F7 unavailable mechanism) and null control invalid (F6). Architectural precondition fails (F1). A more precise classification is MEASUREMENT_INVALID for the transfer/amortization test and a negative on precondition for this sample.
validity_findings.impact: Downstream readers may treat untestable clauses as 'failed' rather than 'not measured'.

stable_identifier_prevalence.recomputation_note: Count matches: total_stable=3, total_spans=50. Denominator definition per episode (not per individual read span) as implemented.

tokens_per_observation_mean.note: 11900 tokens / 100 requests; actual varies by site (35-200). Differs from 763-token baseline due to API vs HTML structural content.

false_replay_rate_NULL_STATE_KEYED.note: No false replays recorded; discriminating condition absent on read-only TEST sites.

claim_ceiling: For the tested credential-free API sample (5 sites, read-only), stable identifier prevalence is ~6% (instrument-limited) which does not meet the preregistered >10% architectural precondition. The parameterized transfer mechanism (INHERITED_PARAMETERIZED) is unavailable in the product kernel, so transfer correctness/amortization cannot be evaluated. The mandatory null control produces 0% false replays on read-only endpoints (not discriminating), preventing validation of the synthetic false-replay finding. No positive support exists for C-CROSSSITE's full claim; at most a bounded negative on precondition and a measurement-incomplete result on transfer/amortization for this substrate selection.

Whether a properly implemented distill_parameterized() would enable transfer correctness/amortization above baselines on true holdout sites.

How the episode-level denominator definition for prevalence affects the estimate relative to per-span counting.
